name: Plain view probe
description: Benchmark fixture: a view whose document region shows one text line, the floor of a view drag, and a section view with the section-view contract.

commands.name: probeplain.measure
commands.description: Starts or stops the observation of the document size and returns the source clock at its start.

commands.name: probeplain.content.read
commands.description: Answers the text that the document region of the view shows, once its document has reported it.
